name: How often should a house be repainted in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: How often should a house be repainted in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of exterior repainting for a home in Southern California can vary based on several factors, including climate exposure, previous paint quality, and the type of siding. Generally, a good quality paint job can last 5-10 years. Homes exposed to intense sun, sea spray, or significant weather fluctuations might need repainting sooner. Regular inspections for chipping, fading, or peeling can help determine the optimal time for a new coat, protecting your home's exterior and maintaining its appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Southern California, exterior house paint typically lasts 5-10 years, depending on sun exposure, weather, and paint quality. Regular inspections help determine the best time to repaint.
